title.zh: Crypto Billionaires Hand Reform UK $97M in Record Donations
title.en: Crypto Billionaires Hand Reform UK $97M in Record Donations

current_state.zh: Crypto billionaires Ben Delo and Christopher Harborne donated a record £72 million ($97 million) to Nigel Farage's Reform UK in two days, surpassing all UK political donations from the previous year combined.
